snippet.title: Arcade Game: Vanguard II (1984 SNK)
snippet.description:
A shooting 'em up game sequel to the 1981 original arcade game.

Gameplay starts at 1:22

Note: Used invinciliblity cheat after down to last life. The game is endless as it repeats the last level after you've beaten it so I quit afterwards
